name: Ginger Garlic Tofu Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tbsp each minced ginger and garlic
1 tsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Sear the tofu in a non-stick pan with half the oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Heat the remaining oil on high; stir-fry ginger and garlic for 20 seconds.
Add the carrot and broccoli and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then the pepper for 1 minute.
Return the tofu with the soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and 2 tbsp water.
Stir in the cornflour mixture and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
note: A quick weeknight stir-fry with no sesame oil or nuts.
